svg.title: agent-brain: one memory, every agent
svg.desc: agent-brain: one memory, every agent. 11 components in 5 groups. Connections: Agent hosts to brain mcp (stdio MCP); Claude Code to Claude Code plugin (loads); brain mcp to Fact pages (BM25 recall, writes); brain mcp to INDEX.md (rebuilds); Fact pages to CI (export public pages, PR); CI to brain/learnings (merge at 0 problems); brain/learnings to Fact pages (install.sh --seed).

text.tspan: Claude Code, Codex and Kiro read and write the same markdown brain over stdio MCP.
